name: Spoon
description: The household shopping list and recipe book.
_comment_display: fullscreen, not standalone. An installed WebAPK bakes its status-bar colour from theme_color at install time and ignores <meta name=theme-color> thereafter, and Chrome never colours the Android gesture bar at all - so in standalone the two bars are constants that cannot follow the light/dark theme. Fullscreen removes them and lets the page paint the whole screen, which is the only way they always match. display_override falls back to standalone where fullscreen is unsupported.
_comment_colours: Read at install time; no media queries in the manifest spec, so these cannot follow the theme. In fullscreen they only tint the splash. Dark Cobalt because both phones run dark.
